svg.text: Back paddles and macros.
EasySMX paddles don't have a button of their own: each one sends an ordinary
button. So in PC mode, each macro slot is played by a real button you pick in the Macros tab, and that
button plays the macro instead of its usual job.
Up to four controllers at once, each with its own settings
and its own virtual Xbox controller, in the same
order.
Settings per game.
Give a running game its own settings; X20CTL switches to them while that game is in
front, and back to
Every game
otherwise.
Hold View + Menu for a second
to switch your settings off mid-game, and again to switch them back on.
Share settings
as a file or as a short code to paste in a chat. Only the settings go in, never anything about
you or your PC.
It's on by default but does nothing until you change a setting, and it only works while X20CTL is open.
The first time, it installs two small drivers by Nefarius:
ViGEmBus
(the virtual controller) and
HidHide
(hides
the real one). Their official installers are inside the exe, checked against pinned hashes. Remove them any
time from Windows Settings → Apps.
Turbo and macros can get you banned in online games.
You are responsible for the rules of the games
you play.
